text:
Aria: Quick preflight check — we have the SDK + docs + quickstarts bundle going out tomorrow. Pulling together owners and known deps. Who's on final sign-off?
Sam: I can do SDK verification (smoke + major examples). ETA by EOD.
Mike: I'll run a dry-run publish to the staging registry shortly, calling out any packaging issues. @Sam can you watch the auth bits?
Carmen: Docs pass is almost finished. Need a confirm on the new install example (we changed flags).
Oliver: Quickstarts updated to the new auth flow but one sample (k8s-deploy) still uses old env var names — PR #492.
Aria: Thanks — assigning owners: SDK -> Sam, Packaging/publish -> Mike, Docs -> Carmen, Quickstarts -> Oliver, Changelog/editorial -> Chris.
Chris: I'll draft the changelog blurb and link to the final PRs. Need PR numbers and any breaking notes by 18:00 PST.
Sam: Found one regression in v2.1.3—streaming example times out on CI. Repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"hello","stream":true}'
# times out after 20s in current staging image
```
Mike: Interesting — packaging image uses older runtime flag. I pushed a quickfix to branch fix/stream-timeout. Will kick a rebuild.
build-bot: CI pipeline started for fix/stream-timeout (#497) — tests queued. :gear:
Carmen: Docs change for install — replace `--use-new-runtime` with `--runtime=compact` (matches the runtime flag in the new image). I'll update TOC and include a short note under "upgrade notes."
Oliver: PR #492 updated to reference the new env var names. I left a TODO to add a troubleshooting snippet for token refresh failures.
Sam: Once CI from build-bot is green, I'll re-run the SDK smoke tests. If all green, we can tag the release candidate.
Chris: For changelog: include migration note about the runtime flag and quickstart env var rename. Also add a small note about streaming timeout fix. That should be enough for the user-facing blurb.
Aria: Blockers? Any cross-team infra deps we should call out?
Mike: One infra ask — need the staging registry creds for the k8s quickstart test. @ops can we get temporary creds scoped to `devex-preflight`?
Chris: Ops pinged via DM.
Carmen: Also want a short test matrix: OS (mac/linux), python versions (3.9/3.10), node (14/16). Sam can we run those in the smoke?
Sam: Yes, I'll run matrix parallelized, but it might take ~45m.
build-bot: CI for #497 passed — all tests green. :white_check_mark:
Mike: Rebuilt image pushed to staging registry `staging.redwood.dev/devex:v2.1.3-rc1`. Sam, rerun when ready.
Sam: Starting smoke matrix now. Will report back if anything flakey.
Oliver: Planning to cut quickstarts release tag once Sam confirms SDK smoke.
Carmen: Docs PR linked here: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/210 — awaiting final wording from Chris.
Chris: Changelog draft in https://github.com/redwood/changelogs/pull/88. I'll merge once I get the final PR numbers (SDK #495, quickstarts #492, packaging #497).
Aria: Great — final checklist for tomorrow: 1) SDK smoke green (Sam) 2) Staging image verified (Mike) 3) Docs and changelog merged (Carmen/Chris) 4) Quickstarts tag cut (Oliver). If we hit all, proceed with the RC publish at 10:00 PST.
Sam: On it. Will update by 09:30 PST with status.
Mike: I'll stay on call at 09:15 to help if publish hiccups happen.
Aria: Awesome, thanks everyone. Ping here for any last-minute regressions. :rocket:
